finalText:
File ends there, at line 719. No recovery logged.

Redis dropped at 02:14:07 (`connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`), and the app never got it back — reconnect attempts failed every ~90 seconds, 12 tries in a row. With no cache, every request fell through to the store, which couldn't keep up: timeouts, growing queue depth, cache miss storms, all piling up for 17 straight minutes. Queue depth climbed from 52 to over 550, way past the max of 500. At 02:31:44 a worker ran out of memory from the backlog and crashed, and eight seconds later the whole API gave up and the process group was killed. Service down at 02:31:52, and the log stops there with no recovery.

Root cause: Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` went unreachable and never came back. Next step is checking why that box dropped.
